note: 本文件由生成器产出，禁止手改。参数表真源 = dsh/gateway/*-plugin.mjs 的 defineTool 参数表；改插件后重跑 `node scripts/build-mcp-contract.mjs`（test/smoke-mcp-server.js 会钉住一致性）。

tools.name: mtnode_canvas_get
tools.description:
Read the canvas this run belongs to: workflow identity + the nodes in the current task / super scope, plus marks / wires / groups / trees / app references when asked. Always read before editing.
DEFAULTS TO THE CHEAPEST FORM — detail "minimal": one index line per node (only title / note / kind 标题 / 描述 / 类别) + workflow identity and scopeInfo; no config fields, no bodies, no wire / mark / group / tree block. Ask for more only when needed:
- "standard": + all per-kind config fields (provider / model / size / savePath / waitPath / timer / net / control / dev*, db_table rows, input_file files, task steps, 素材节点的绑定与条目清单), body *lengths* (no body text) and the build references (markColors, devFuncColors 功能色卡, cam / view) — 不含 kinds / imageSizes / defaultImageSize；要这三张静态表显式传 sections:["refs"]。
- "full": everything incl. body text (text, prompt, task, goal, jscode, 素材条目正文), rows, files, steps — ask explicitly, best with ids:[...] so only those nodes come back heavy.
- Narrow with ids / scope + scopeDepth / bodies / bodyLimit, or sections = whitelist of heavy blocks (nodes, marks, wires, groups, and the trees / tagCatalog / workflows / selection). 只查连线用 sections:["nodes","wires"]（minimal 档也认）。素材节点（kind asset）也回读：assetItems = 绑定与条目清单 items:[{index, id, title, type}]（条目即端子：第 i 入 ↔ 第 i 出，端子名 = 条目标题）；text/body 档每条再带 text（文本正文）或 path / url（本机文件）。
- ports (standard / full): fixed-port nodes (proc_image / video_gen / remotion / judge / tool·function / super / asset) carry ports:[{dir,index,name,kind,connectedTo}] — read before connecting, not after a connect error.
- portRule (standard / full): nodes whose input ports GROW WITH WIRES (proc_text / proc_image / remotion / input_* …) carry portRule {note,input,output,now,hint} instead: ports only lists the slots that exist right now (an unconnected node shows one data port + one control port), and further slots appear as you connect — remotion is the one node whose data AND control lines share the same ports (never assume port 0 = control for remotion), and its description (功能说明) lives in the node text (not in a port) — the build brief is remotionBuildNote, only used when the user clicks 构建. For these dynamic-port nodes (except remotion) the control input is always the LAST, dedicated control port — it sits after the data slots, data wires never take it, and several control wires may share it (any one arrival triggers a single run). Never infer "this node has only one port" from a short ports list, and never test-wire just to read the warnings.
- 参数（standard / full）: 有配置的节点（有 ⚙ 设置窗）末位有「参数」端子，端子号恒 9001；快照带 paramKeys（可覆写的键）。函数 / 工具节点同样有 9001，但语义不同：函数节点那份 JSON 进 input.params（不改节点字段），工具节点那份是内部图的共享参数、内部函数节点自动继承。参数只能由一根文本节点的 JSON 经这颗端子传入（toIndex 9001），没有「直接改节点参数」的写法。
scopeInfo is always returned（这次读的是整图还是某一颗壳内部）; every result carries a sizeHint with its cost.

When the run is locked to its own canvas（会话所属画布）, workflows lists ONLY that canvas. 建图 / 连线 / 排版的完整硬规则（task 端点、super 边界端子、tool/function 参数即端子、@引用三条件、save 与 wait_file、批次与文生图）只写在技能 mtnode-canvas-edit-rules（按需加载），此处不重复。

detail.description: Node field granularity. DEFAULT (when omitted) = "minimal": per node only title / note / kind (标题 / 描述 / 类别) — no id, no position, no status, no config fields, no bodies, and no heavy block (marks / wires / groups / trees) either. standard = minimal + all per-kind config fields (provider/model/size/paths/timer/net/control/…, db_table rows, input_file files, task steps) + body *lengths* only, no body text, and the build references (markColors, devFuncColors, cam/view) — WITHOUT kinds / imageSizes / defaultImageSize; get those three static tables explicitly with sections:["refs"]. full = everything incl. full text bodies (input_text.text, prompt, task, goal, jscode), rows, files, steps — you must ask for it explicitly, ideally with ids:[...] so only the nodes you need come back heavy.

ids.description: Return ONLY these nodes (match by node id or unique title). Wires are restricted to the selected nodes. Use with detail:"full" to fetch a single node's complete config cheaply.

scope.description: Read ONLY the inside of this super / dev / db node (id or unique title). "global" = whole canvas. Inspect one shell without pulling the whole graph into context.

scopeDepth.description: With scope: "direct" = that shell plus its direct children (default) · "all" = the whole subtree underneath it.

bodies.description: Include full body text (text/prompt/task/goal, and 素材节点各条目的正文 / 媒体路径). Default: true when detail="full", false otherwise. When false, *Len counts are still returned.

bodyLimit.description: Truncate each body value to N characters (0 = no limit, default). *Len fields always report the true length.

sections.description: Whitelist of the heavy top-level blocks: nodes, marks, wires, groups, taskTree, superTree, tagCatalog, workflows, selection, plus refs = 三张静态建图表 kinds / imageSizes / defaultImageSize. At detail "minimal" ONLY nodes is returned unless you name others here（只查连线就用 ["nodes","wires"]）; at "standard" / "full" the default is all of them and this list narrows it — EXCEPT refs: 它在任何档位都默认缺席，只有显式点名才回。The small envelope (workflow, scopeInfo, assistScope / scopeNote) is always included.

tools.name: mtnode_app
tools.description:
Control the MTNode desktop app beyond node graph edits (workflow status, rename, select nodes, undo/redo, delete with confirmation, DSH plugin install).

Available actions:
- status / list_workflows: inspect app + workflow catalog. When the run is locked to its own canvas（会话所属画布：agent_task nodes, agent session, assistant "current" scope）, the catalog contains ONLY that canvas — other workflows are omitted.
- rename_workflow: rename the canvas this run belongs to (or a specified workflow) — other canvases are rejected when locked
- create_longtask: store a long-running-task state-machine graph (DAG) into the canvas this run belongs to; the graph and its landing points (node-layer shells / generation workflows / deliverable nodes) are placed on the canvas at creation time — nothing runs — and the task stays disabled (the user enables it from the strip to start it). When to use: once a requirements-grilling session has reached consensus — load the mtnode-grill-me skill and follow its graph contract for what goes into graph (the contract is the single source of truth; do not invent fields); pass name = task name, graph = the graph. Rejected with the validation errors if the graph does not pass, so fix and call again.
- get_longtask: read one existing long-running task in full — its identity (uid / name / ver / enabled), the whole graph definition, and the LIVE run state (run status, per-node status by path, who is blocked, who is being waited on). Pass uid (omit = the canvas's active task). Always call this before update_longtask: the state graph the user wants changed is only knowable from here.
- update_longtask: replace the graph definition of an EXISTING long-running task in place (same task, same uid; ver +1). When to use: the user asks to change / fix a task chain that already exists — pass uid plus the complete revised graph (not a diff; the graph replaces the old one). The task keeps its name / enabled / run; if a run is in progress it keeps running on the old snapshot (the receipt says so) and the user must re-enable to apply the new graph. Rejected with the validation errors if the graph does not pass, so fix and call again. Creating a brand-new task is create_longtask instead.
- select_nodes: select nodes by id/title (optional; empty clears selection). Selection highlight only — it acts on the canvas on screen, so it is rejected when this run's own canvas is in the background.
- undo / redo: undo or redo the last canvas edit — same foreground-only rule (the undo stack belongs to the canvas you see).
- export_canvas_png: take a high-resolution PNG "photo" of the whole canvas this run belongs to — every node, wire and mark, tiled and stitched exactly like the app's footer camera button (生成高清总览图). Read-only: nothing on the canvas changes. Like select_nodes it acts on the canvas on screen, so it is rejected when this run's own canvas is in the background (switch to it first); the host briefly reveals the canvas and restores the view afterwards, so the user sees a short pan. Pass path to choose an absolute .png destination; omit it and the PNG is written into that canvas's asset folder. The receipt returns the file path — hand it to mtnode_vision when you actually need to READ the picture (OCR / layout / verifying what was built), or give it to the user as a deliverable.
- list_dsh_plugins: list DSH agent plugins (id, package name, enabled/disabled, core/user). Does not restart the engine.

Needs user confirmation (UI will prompt; may be rejected):
- delete_workflow: permanently delete a workflow and its local assets (other canvases rejected when locked)
- install_dsh_plugin: install a DSH plugin (npm package name, GitHub URL, local path, or .tgz). Pass pkg. Engine restarts after install. Packages are stored under the app config data directory (survive app updates).
- remove_dsh_plugin: remove a user-installed DSH plugin. Pass pkg (package name). Bundled suites can only be unmounted via set_dsh_plugin.
- set_dsh_plugin: mount or unmount a non-core plugin. Pass pkg and enabled (boolean); optional id when multiple rows share a name.

For creating/editing/wiring/removing NODES or canvas drawings (marks) on the canvas this run belongs to（会话所属画布，不是用户此刻看到的这张）, use mtnode_canvas_edit instead (confirmed when called from the global assistant or the agent-session view; rejection stops the agent session).

node.description: For select_nodes: node id or unique title.

nodes.description: For select_nodes: multiple ids or unique titles.

workflow.description: For rename/delete: workflow id or exact name — when the run is locked to its own canvas（会话所属画布）, that canvas is the only valid target.

name.description: For rename_workflow / create_longtask: display name (for create_longtask it is optional; defaults to a numbered long-running task name). For update_longtask: optional new name for that task.

uid.description: For get_longtask / update_longtask: target long-running task uid. Omit = the canvas's active task.

graph.description: For create_longtask / update_longtask: the long-running-task state-machine graph. For update_longtask pass the COMPLETE revised graph — it replaces the stored definition (not a diff, not just the changed nodes). The graph contract (nodes / edges and their per-kind cfg) is the single source of truth in the mtnode-grill-me skill — do not invent fields.

pkg.description: For install_dsh_plugin / remove_dsh_plugin / set_dsh_plugin: npm package, GitHub URL, local path, .tgz, or installed package name.

path.description: For export_canvas_png: absolute .png output path. Omit = the PNG is written into the canvas asset folder and that path is returned.

plugin.description: Alias of pkg for DSH plugin actions.

enabled.description: For set_dsh_plugin: true = mount, false = unmount.

id.description: For set_dsh_plugin: optional cordis row id when disambiguating.

tools.name: mtnode_canvas_edit
tools.description:
在当前画布上创建 / 修改 / 连线 / 删除 / 分组 / 自动排版节点，并用 createMarks / updateMarks / removeMarks 画装饰（text / box / arrow）。先 mtnode_canvas_get 读图，再在一次调用里建完整子图；alias 只在本调用内有效（connect / update / refs 用它）。回执自足（坐标 / 端口占用 + warnings），不必回读；要复核别的节点或取正文再用 mtnode_canvas_get（ids:[...]）。

create.kind 枚举见 schema（生成族含 music_gen / yue_gen / breeze_gen / video_gen / remotion）。端子语义：tool / function 的参数表就是端子表（输入端子 0 = 控制入、1..N 各入参；输出 0..M-1 各出参、末位控制出）；judge 只有两个输出：fromIndex 0 = YES、1 = NO；super 对外只暴露边界端子，跨壳 / 跨层级用 superConnect。

参数：节点参数**只能通过「参数」端子**给 —— 建一颗 input_text 写参数 JSON，再 connect（来源 → 目标节点，toIndex 9001）；键 = canvas_get 的 paramKeys。create / update 里带 params 会被整笔拒绝。paramStrict:true = 参数端子上的 JSON 有键不合法就整份拒绝、该节点不运行。breeze_gen 的角色 / 组走名称参数 breezePreset（角色名称，或角色 id）+ breezeGroup（组名 / 「第 N 组」/ 组 id；不给 = 该角色第一组）：运行期临时翻译，跑完恢复、不写回节点；对不上就报错并停止这次合成（绝不默默换声）。

不变量（违反即接线错）：
- 标题必须唯一。端子先看 canvas_get 的 ports / portRule 再接线，别试连反推；动态端子的专用控制入恒为末位那颗，数据线不占它。
- @引用：连线源在 prompt/task 里写 @标题（@标签名 注入带该标签的全部节点）；全局广播须同时接 kind "global" + globalRefs:true + 明文 @。
- 智能节点（agent_task、agent:true 的 proc_text）自己会写文件：其后不接 save、也不当数据输入；用 wait_file 控制线挡下游。
- 图像生成节点（proc_image）每次运行只出 1 张图；batchMode "batch" 每条一次运行、每次只看该条（严禁把整批 N 条再灌进每次运行），一次看全部用 "agg"。
- 跨节点层只能经边界端子中转：connect 遇跨层自动改写成逐层链，superConnect 同一口径；任何入口都不许留下「层内节点直连层外」的线。
- 改结构的编辑默认自动排版；绝不删除或与正在运行本任务的节点重叠；改完告诉用户可编辑输入并用 control ▶ 重跑。

字段只给一句：每个字段的完整语义、save 与 wait_file、task 三端、@引用、批次与文生图、数据库 / 开发节点 / 排版 / scope 细则只在技能 mtnode-canvas-edit-rules（开发节点另见 mtnode-dev-architect；建图 / 连线 / 批量 / 媒体前先加载它们）。

create.description: 要新增的节点；alias 必填，本次调用内的 connect / update / refs 用它引用这个新节点。

kind.description: 节点类型（必填）；图像参考节点用 input_image。

title.description: 唯一标题；@标题 引用它。

text.description: input_text 正文；remotion 功能说明也在这。

scope.description: 局部画布：本次只在这一颗壳内（id 或唯一标题；"global" = 整图）。

note.description: super 卡片说明（开发节点必须两段：【功能】+【实现】）。

devModel.description: dev：本块 Agent 模型 id（建议 / 开发 / 细化会话按此三项下达；子块继承）。

name.description: 工具名（标题默认跟随它）。

inputs.description: 输入端子表（传完整数组）。

outputs.description: 输出端子表（末位控制出不在表内）。

jscode.description: input = 参数对象 → return 输出对象。

inputs.description: 输入端子表（整体替换）；list = 数组端子。

outputs.description: 输出端子表（末位控制出不在表内）。

agent.description: 已下线：只接受 false（关闭旧画布的文本智能模式）；true 会被忽略。

batchMode.description: batch 每条一次 / agg 一次看全部。

maskOn.description: 蒙版重绘（透明区 = 重绘）。

remotionBuildNote.description: 构建需求（只有它进构建 Agent）。

remotionInputs.description: 端子契约（通常由源码派生）。

voice.description: breeze_gen 音色 id；空 = 用端子音频。

videoMode.description: 首末帧 / 多参考；端口见技能。

workflowId.description: ComfyUI 工作流库 id（勿编造）。

dbNodeId.description: 镜像的数据库 super id。

update.description: 补丁已有或本次新建的节点：按 id / alias / 唯一标题定位，可改字段与 create[] 同一份属性表（kind 不可改）。

items.description: 可改字段与 create[] 的属性表同一份（省略的键保持原样，数组整体替换；kind 不可改）。

title.description: 按现有标题查找（须唯一）。

connect.description: 连线：源 → 目标。表达关系的 UML 直线（不传数据、不参与执行）用 rel:true + relLabel / relArrow。

from.description: 源节点：id / alias / 唯一标题。

to.description: 目标节点：id / alias / 唯一标题。

fromIndex.description: 源的输出端子序号（默认 0）；judge 0 = YES、1 = NO；tool / function 按参数表数端子。

toIndex.description: 输入端子号（0 起始；省略 = 自动落点）。参数端子 = 9001；媒体 / 动态端子的槽位表见技能；接已占用的普通端子 = 替换旧线。

rel.description: 关系线：UML 直线，不传数据也不参与执行（忽略 fromIndex）。

relLabel.description: 关系线文字（如 调用 / 依赖）。

disconnect.description: 删除匹配 from→to 的连线；字段与 connect[] 同一份表（from / to / fromIndex，断关系线带 rel:true）。

superConnect.description: 跨 super / 跨层级连通两个节点：[{from,to}]（字段同 connect[]）。按「内 → 直属壳输出端子 → … → 目标壳输入端子 → 内」逐层桥接，每段只连直接父子，绝不越级；同一对重复调用不新建线。需 canvas_super。

remove.description: 要删除的节点 id / alias / 唯一标题；正在运行本任务的节点删不掉。

group.description: 把节点与绘制打包成组（整组一起移动 / 缩放）；分区框建议一并放进来。

nodes.description: 要包含的节点 / 绘制 id、alias 或标题；省略 = 本次 create[] 的全部节点。

marks.description: 要包含的绘制 id / alias / 精确正文。

createMarks.description: 画布绘制（text / box / arrow）；优先 box + around:[alias] + label 划分区，在节点自动排版之后贴合生成。

alias.description: 本调用内局部名（updateMarks / removeMarks / group 引用）。

kind.description: text 文字 · box 分区框 · arrow 箭头。

around.description: box 框住哪些节点（id / alias / 标题）。

marks.description: createMarks 的旧别名，字段完全相同。

updateMarks.description: 改已有绘制（按 id / createMarks 的 alias / 精确正文定位）。

items.description: 按 id | alias | 精确正文（title）定位，其余字段同 createMarks[]。

title.description: 按精确正文查找（须唯一）。

removeMarks.description: 要删除的绘制 id / alias / 精确正文。

layout.description: 自动排版：改结构的编辑默认自动执行，传 false 跳过。

setWorkflowName.description: 改当前画布标签名（可选）。

detail.description: 回执口径：summary（默认）= 计数摘要 + created/updated 明细（含 x/y/w/h 与端口占用）；diff = 只回本次 created/updated/connected/removed 明细，不回计数摘要。回执已自足，无需回读画布。

tools.name: mtnode_vision
tools.description:
Vision subagent: inspect a local image with a multimodal (vision) model and return a text answer. Use when you need to READ pixels mid-task — e.g. game UI layout, screenshot OCR, icon/button recognition, verifying a generated image — without wiring a permanent vision node.

Requirements:
- imagePath must be an absolute path on THIS machine (workflow asset path, screenshot file, etc.).
- question: what to look for (Chinese OK). Be specific.
- FIRST CALL in this app requires user permission (host shows Allow once / Always allow / Deny), unless the user already set Always allow / full-access / session allow in the top-right Approvals button.
- The host picks a vision model by provider order then model order in Settings → Model services (DeepSeek Official's deepseek-flash reads images natively; any other vision-capable OpenAI-compatible provider works too).
- Prefer this over attaching large image batches to the main agent prompt (saves tokens; avoids N² batch mistakes).
- Do not use for generating new images — only for understanding existing ones.

imagePath.description: Absolute path to a local image file to inspect.

question.description: What to look for / ask about the image (e.g. describe the game HUD and list clickable buttons).

model.description: Optional vision model id; omit to use the host default vision route.

tools.name: mtnode_db
tools.description:
Grounded fact lookup for the database wired into the CURRENT task — OR any database referenced by writing !@数据库标题 in your prompt/task. Use it whenever the task needs facts — names, numbers, prices, paths, terms, statuses — instead of answering from memory. Facts NEVER come from your parameters: only this tool's returned records are truth.

Actions (full CRUD): list / query / get / calc / write / delete — arguments are documented on each parameter. list first to see what the database knows; query returns provenance (record ids/titles/sources) + sql + data; get returns one full record by id; write/delete take a record / ids (omit id = insert a new record, matching id = update it).

When the run references more than one database (via !@ or wired replicas), pass database: "<title or folder>" to scope an action to a single database; otherwise the action applies to every referenced database.

Discipline (enforced by the host):
- Every key assertion in your answer MUST cite [记录id · 标题] from the provenance of a query/get result.
- If query/get finds nothing, say exactly "数据库中没有该信息" — do not guess, do not fill in from memory.
- If the host rejects the call (未接入数据库), the database is unavailable: say so, and do NOT answer from memory.
- Facts not in the database may only appear explicitly labelled as 推断, with "数据库未记载".
- ALL number/date math must go through calc — never compute in your head.
- Prefer query before write: confirm a record id does not already exist before writing a duplicate.

q.description: query: keywords or a question; optional field filters title:xxx file:xxx kind:fact|file|meta.

id.description: get: record id from list/query results.

expr.description: calc: arithmetic expression, numbers and + - * / % ( ) only.

record.description: write: a single record to upsert (id, title, content, kind, source, file). Omit id to insert a new record (id auto-generated). Use records for an array.

records.description: write: array of records to upsert. Each takes title, content, optional kind/source/file; include an existing id to update that record, or omit id to insert a new one (id auto-generated).

ids.description: delete: array of record ids to remove.

database.description: Optional database title or folder to scope this action to (else it applies to all referenced databases).

tools.name: mtnode_manifest
tools.description:
Project asset registry + dependency graph + incremental rebuild for the CURRENT project (the canvas working folder, or an explicit root). The file is <root>/manifest.json.

Why use it: consistency stops depending on prompts. Register every character / scene / prop as an ASSET (with its files), register every SHOT as a consumer of specific asset versions (assets: ["char_lin@3"]), and the host can then tell you exactly which shots must be rebuilt after an asset changes.

Actions:
- init: create manifest.json (refuses nothing else — every other action errors if the project is not initialized).
- get: read the whole registry (project / rev / assets / shots / edges / needsReview). Always get before writing.
- asset_set: upsert one asset: {id, kind: character|scene|prop|style|voice|audio|lut|other, files:{slot:"relative/path.png"}, anchor:{model,seed,lora,ref}, deps:[], label}. rev auto-increments ONLY when the content changed (file bytes + anchor + fields); re-registering the same bytes keeps the rev. Every files path must be project-relative and already exist. Pass stage:"art" — writes from any other stage are stored but flagged needsReview.
- asset_del: remove an asset by id (reports which shots still reference it).
- shot_set: upsert one shot: {id, assets:["char_lin@3"], deps:["file:audio/timeline.json"], specRef, final, candidates, qa, gen}. A shot whose assets reference a missing asset or a stale @rev is REJECTED — register/fix the asset first.
- shot_del: remove a shot by id.
- edge_add / edge_del: manual dependency edge {from:"shot:A@2", to:"shot:B@2"} — goes into the graph but does NOT spread stale.
- stale_plan: incremental rebuild plan — stale shots, their revs and the reasons (e.g. asset char_lin 3→4). Rebuild those, then call rebuild_done.
- validate: full check (missing files, missing assets, stale refs). ok:false lists every problem with a path.
- validate_refs: check a list of "id@rev" refs only — use it before generating a shot that must be anchored to assets (requireAsset).
- rebuild_done: {shots:[ids]} clears stale after you actually rebuilt those shots.

Discipline (enforced by the host):
- Never invent asset ids, revs or file paths: read get first, and quote the asset rev the host returned.
- Change an asset only in the art stage; anywhere else the write comes back with needsReview:true — tell the user and wait for confirmation instead of treating it as settled.
- After stale_plan says a shot is stale, that shot's old final/qa files are OUT OF DATE — do not present them as current.
- Stale spreads to DIRECT downstream shots only (not transitively).

root.description: Project root (folder containing manifest.json). Omit to use the current canvas working folder.

stage.description: Writing stage (art / script / storyboard / audio / shot / qa). Only "art" writes skip the needsReview flag.

expectRev.description: Optimistic lock: the manifest rev you last read. A mismatch rejects the write and returns the current rev.

id.description: asset_del / shot_del: the id to remove.

asset.description: asset_set: {id, kind, label?, files:{slot:"rel/path"}, anchor?, deps?}. files paths must be project-relative and already exist.

shot.description: shot_set: {id, assets:["id@rev"], deps?["file:rel/path"], specRef?, final?, candidates?, qa?, gen?}.

from.description: edge_add / edge_del: source node key, e.g. shot:S03_005@2.

to.description: edge_add / edge_del: target node key, e.g. shot:S03_006@1.

refs.description: validate_refs: asset references to check, each "id@rev" (use before generating an asset-anchored shot).

shots.description: rebuild_done: shot ids you actually rebuilt; their stale flag is cleared.

ids.description: get: only return these asset / shot ids.

project.description: init: project name written into manifest.json.

tools.name: mtnode_facts
tools.description:
AI 事实库（mtnode_facts）：本画布自己的极简条例库 —— 给 AI 读的紧凑索引。要知道「这个项目有哪些模块、关键文件与路径、定了哪些约定、工作流的端口与数据流、命令入口、已知坑」时，先查这里，再去看现文件与数据库。
动作：
- list：全部条目（id | 标题 | 是否保护）。
- query：按关键词检索（q，可选 limit），返回最相关的少量条目；写之前先 query，避免重复。
- get：按 id 取一条全文。
- write：写入极简条例 —— record: {id?, title, text} 或 records: [...]；同标题即更新同一条，省略 id 即新增。
- delete：按 ids 删除条目。
- pin：按 ids 设 on:true（保护，不会被淘汰）/ on:false（取消保护）。
条目纪律：一条一件事、标题可辨、正文只求信息传达，不写过程与废话 —— 命中计数只看被索引的频率，废话只会被淘汰；完整规范见技能 mtnode-ai-facts。
冲突口径：与现文件、数据库记录冲突时，以现文件、数据库为准，并在回答里说明分歧；本库没有或查不到就如实说，不得凭记忆编造。
没有绑定画布时返回「当前没有绑定画布」（工具调用失败，会话继续）。
Use when indexing project content, or recording / recalling the key conclusions of a project's architecture or workflow (modules, file paths, conventions, ports, commands, known pitfalls).

action.description: Which AI fact library action to run.

q.description: query: keywords to search the library with (tags, titles, module names, paths).

id.description: get: entry id from a list/query result.

ids.description: delete / pin: array of entry ids.

record.description: write: a single minimal clause {id?, title, text}. Omit id to insert a new entry (same title updates that entry). Use records for an array.

records.description: write: array of minimal clauses {id?, title, text}; same title = update the existing entry, omit id = insert a new one.

on.description: pin: true = protect the entry from eviction, false = unprotect it.

limit.description: query: max entries to return (1–20, default 8).

tools.name: lt_state
tools.description:
Read / write the shared state of the LONG-RUNNING TASK this node belongs to.

- read (default): returns the whole state object of the current run plus your own node's declared input values. Use it whenever the task needs upstream results — do NOT guess what an earlier step produced.
- write: pass patch = { "<key>": <value> }. You may ONLY write the output keys your own node declared in its task brief (they are listed in the read result as allowedWrite). Writing anything else is rejected by the host — that is deliberate: it keeps one run reproducible.

Values are JSON. Keep big payloads in files and write the PATH into state instead of the whole text.

write.description: true = write patch into state; default false = read.

key.description: read: optional single key to fetch instead of the whole state.

patch.description: write: { key: value } — only your own declared output keys.

tools.name: mtnode_assets
tools.description:
The MTNode asset library (素材库) and full-window still screenshots — for runs that must PREPARE MATERIALS (交付 · 素材交付, 分镜参考图, 界面静帧截图 …). Both live OUTSIDE your workspace, so read_file / shell cannot reach them: every path this tool returns is already host-verified.

Available actions:
- list: the library tree. Returns categories, then assets: [{id, rel, displayName, desc, items:[{index, id, title, type}]}] and root. Pass filter (substring over category path / asset name / description) to narrow it (character turnarounds 三视图 are usually named 「…三视图」), or type:"image" to keep only assets that have an image item. Content items are numbered: item index = the port number of an 素材节点 bound to that asset.
- read: one content item. Pass id (asset id, e.g. "as…") or rel (library-relative folder, e.g. "DS Adventure/Characters/AI娘原人设Q版三视图") or path (an absolute file path you already have), plus itemId (or index, 0-based) to pick the item; type:"image" + limit picks the first N image items. Returns {asset, item, file:{path, bytes}} — text items also come back as text (binary never does). The absolute path is what mtnode_vision eats, and what you hand to a deliver terminal / a save node.
- screenshot: take a still PNG of the MTNode window as it is right now and write it to an absolute path. Defaults: whole window, hidden menus/lightboxes removed, written to the current canvas workspace's .mtnode-input/ when path is omitted (a temporary still — kept out of the asset folder; give an explicit path for anything you must keep). Pass canvasOnly:true to shoot only the canvas viewport (the 起始态/丰富态 UI stills of a delivery list), width/height to force the output pixel size (e.g. 1920x1080 — capture is scaled to fit; it never resizes the user's window), hideUI:false to keep transient UI, maximize:true to enlarge the window first (only when the user is not using it: the window really does resize). FAILS when the window is minimized or hidden — ask the user to show the MTNode window, then retry.

Write actions (permission "assets_write", separate from read; same action set the app window gets):
- create: new asset. {displayName, category?, desc?} — category is a library-relative category path, created when missing. Returns {asset}.
- addItem: new content item in an asset. {id, type, title?, content?} for text, or {id, type, srcPath} / {id, type, base64} for media. Returns {item, asset}.
- importFile: new asset made of local files. {paths:[absolute…], name?, category?, desc?} — files are COPIED into the library. Returns {asset, added, skipped}.
- importFiles: append local files to an existing asset. {id, paths:[…]}. Returns {items, skipped, asset}.
- updateText: overwrite a text item. {id, itemId, content, title?} — the previous body is kept under .versions/. Returns {item, asset, prevVersion, prevEmpty}.
- updateMeta: {id, displayName?, desc?, catRel?} — rename / describe / move to another category. Returns {asset}.
- removeItem: {id, itemId} — file goes to the system trash (restorable). Returns {removed, trash, asset}.
- deleteAsset: {id} — whole asset folder goes to the trash (restorable). Returns {id, trash, rel}.

Discipline: never guess that a file exists — call read and quote the path it returns. Reading is never restricted; writes are gated by the separate "write asset library" permission and every delete goes to the trash, never an unlink. Creating an asset node on the canvas is a canvas action (mtnode_canvas_edit), not this tool.

action.description: Which asset action to run. list / read / screenshot need the "read asset library" permission; every other action needs the separate "write asset library" permission.

filter.description: list: substring over category path / asset display name / description (e.g. "三视图", "AI娘"). Omit to walk the whole library.

type.description: list: keep only assets that hold an item of this type. read: pick an item of this type (with limit) instead of an explicit itemId/index.

limit.description: list: max assets to return (default 60). read: max items to return (default 3, max 20).

id.description: read: asset id from list (looks like "as…").

rel.description: read: library-relative asset folder from list (e.g. "DS Adventure/Characters/AI娘原人设Q版三视图").

path.description: read: an absolute file path already in hand (or under the library) instead of id/rel. screenshot: absolute .png destination; omit to write a temporary still into the canvas workspace's .mtnode-input/ (falling back to the canvas asset folder only when the canvas has no workspace folder).

itemId.description: read: content item id from list (looks like "it…").

index.description: read: 0-based content item index — the same ordinal as an 素材节点 port number.

asText.description: read: for text items include the body (default true). Set false to skip it.

canvasOnly.description: screenshot: shoot only the canvas viewport instead of the whole MTNode window (default false = whole window, the 界面静帧口径).

width.description: screenshot: force the output pixel width (with height); the capture is scaled to fit, the window is NOT resized unless maximize:true. Omit = native capture size.

height.description: screenshot: force the output pixel height. See width.

maximize.description: screenshot: enlarge the MTNode window before shooting (the user sees the window resize; default false). Use only when a bigger still is really needed.

hideUI.description: screenshot: remove transient UI (open menus, hints, lightbox) before shooting (default true) so a delivery still has no残余 popups.

paths.description: importFile / importFiles: absolute paths of local files to COPY into the library. Directories are not walked — pass files.

name.description: importFile: new asset display name (default = first file name without extension). Category is `category`.

displayName.description: create / updateMeta: asset display name shown in the library UI.

category.description: create / importFile: library-relative category path (e.g. "story2video/Stills"). Missing categories are created.

catRel.description: updateMeta: move the asset to this library-relative category ("" = library root).

title.description: addItem / updateText: content item title (becomes the 素材节点 port title).

content.description: addItem (type:"text") / updateText: the text body (text items are stored as .txt).

srcPath.description: addItem: absolute path of one local file to copy in (media items).

base64.description: addItem: inline base64 bytes instead of srcPath (small media only).

tools.name: mtnode_screenshot
tools.description:
截屏标注（mtnode_screenshot）：请用户在本机截一块屏幕、顺手标注，或者让他直接给你一张已有的图片／一句话，再把结果交回来。
什么时候用：用户说「截个图看看」「这里不对」「照着这个改」，或你需要看见用户屏幕上的真实界面 / 报错 / 设计稿才能判断时。**不要**让用户自己截图再粘贴 —— 调用这个工具，弹出来的对话框会替他做完。
发生什么（不会一上来就抢屏）：先弹一只对话框，用户在里面写一句话（跟会话输入框一样，可留空），也可以填 / 选一张本机图片的绝对路径 ——
 · 填了路径 → 直接把那张图交回来（不拍屏，回执带 supplied:true）；
 · 只写一句话 → 这句话就是回执（没有图）；
 · 点「开始截图…」→ 才冻结鼠标所在那块屏，他框选区域 → 在裁剪图上用矩形 / 箭头 / 画笔 / 文字 / 编号图钉标注，每条标注能写一句备注；完成后 PNG 落到本机 captures 目录，剪贴板里同时写好 Markdown（图 + 编号清单）。
返回什么：{ ok, path, markdown, width, height, notes:[{n, kind, x, y, w, h, text}], text?, supplied? }。path 是本机绝对路径（可直接喂给读图能力）；markdown 里的坐标全部是裁剪图内像素、原点在左上角；notes 的 n 与图上红点数字一一对应；text = 用户在对话框里写的那句话（可能没有）；supplied:true = 这张图是用户给你的路径，不是本次截的。
用户取消（按 Esc / 点取消 / 对话框里什么都没给）：返回 canceled:true —— 这是正常收场，不要重试、不要再问一遍同样的东西，改用别的办法或直接问他要文字描述。
纪律：一张图只截一块区域（他框哪儿就是哪儿）；坐标与备注只转述工具返回的内容，不要自己编；图里的文字看不清就说看不清，别猜。

reason.description: 给用户看的一句话：为什么要这张图 / 要看什么（会显示在对话框最上面，让他知道该框哪里、或者该给哪张图）。例如「看一下这个页面右侧被裁掉的按钮」。

tools.name: mtnode_gui
tools.description:
Drive the MTNode desktop UI (the Electron app's windows) and shoot stills of them. Use it when the work is a *window* action rather than a canvas edit: opening a plugin's dialog or an app's own window on the real machine, pressing "开始安装" in the install window, starting a local backend, hitting its "test generate" button, reading an error dialog.

App development: action:"open-app" opens (or reloads, then focuses) an MTNode app's own window — the real window the user sees, with window.appHost injected — and returns its id / title / directory. Pass app = the app id from that app's app.json (kind:"dev" / "down" picks which copy when the same id exists in both roots; omit it to use the one present on disk). Then target that window by a substring of the returned title (e.g. "我的应用 (开发目录 v1.0.0)").

Windows: pass which = "main" (default, the main window) · "install" (the plugin install window) · "any" (focused window) · or any substring of a window title (e.g. "Minimax H3" — plugin console windows are titled after the plugin). Call action:"windows" first when you are unsure what is open.

Element targets (used by click / type / set / scroll / wait): an object with ONE of
- { css: "…" } — CSS selector;
- { text: "…", exact?: true, index?: 0 } — visible text; default substring match, deepest/shortest node wins, index picks among ties;
- { title: "…" } — substring of aria-label / title / data-tip / placeholder;
- { role: "button", name: "…" } — role-ish match on button / a / [role=button] / input plus a name substring;
- { ref: "r7" } — a ref returned by action:"outline" (stable until the page re-renders; re-run outline if it goes stale).
Add includeHidden:true to allow a hidden element (rarely useful — a user could not click it either).

Actions:
- open-app: open (or reload and focus) an MTNode app's own window: app = its id, optional kind:"dev"|"down". Returns {ok, id, title, dir}. Pass a substring of the returned title as which afterwards.
- windows: list every window (id / title / url / visible / minimized). Read-only.
- outline: compact structure snapshot — visible interactive elements with a ref each, plus the window's visible text lines (textMax, default 80, 0 = none). This is how you learn what to click. Read-only, capped at 120 items.
- text: visible text lines of the window (offset / limit). Read-only.
- click: click a target (a real DOM click inside the page, so the page's own handlers run). mode:"dblclick" for double click; force:true to click a disabled element anyway.
- type: focus a target (or the focused element) and type text; clear:true (default) empties it first; submit:true presses Enter afterwards. Works on input / textarea / contenteditable through the native value setter, so framework listeners fire. NEVER use it for passwords or any credential.
- set: assign a value to a form element: text input, textarea, select (by value or option text), checkbox / radio (true/false), contenteditable.
- key: press one key on the focused element (Enter / Escape / Tab / Backspace / arrows / PageDown / a single character).
- scroll: scroll the window, or a target container, by dx / dy.
- wait: wait until a target appears, until text appears (text:"…"), or until a target is gone (gone:true). timeoutMs default 15000, max 600000.
- eval: run a small READ-ONLY expression inside the window and return its value (diagnostics; use click / type / set for anything that changes state).
- screenshot: write a still PNG/JPG of a window to an absolute path (path is required). canvasOnly:true shoots just the canvas viewport, hideUI:true hides transient menus and the image lightbox first, delayMs waits before shooting. Fails when the window is minimized / hidden — bring it up first.

Discipline: every action returns {ok, window, element?: {tag,id,cls,text,label}} and, on failure, a readable error saying what was not found — read it and adjust instead of retrying blindly. After a click that changes the page, either rely on the automatic short settle or follow with action:"wait". Screenshots are written ONLY to the path you pass.

app.description: open-app: the app id (from that app's app.json). The app window is opened (or reloaded and focused when already open) and its id / title / directory are returned — use a substring of that title as which for the following actions.

kind.description: open-app: which copy to open when the same id exists in both roots — "dev" (project root) or "down" (download root). Omit to use the copy present on disk.

which.description: Target window: "main" (default) · "install" (the plugin install window) · "any" (focused) · or a substring of the window title.

target.description: Element target: {css} or {text, exact?, index?} or {title} or {role, name?} or {ref} (from outline), plus optional includeHidden.

text.description: type: the text to type. wait: the text to wait for.

value.description: set: the value to assign (select takes the option value or its text; true/false for checkbox / radio).

key.description: key: the key to press on the focused element (Enter / Escape / Tab / Backspace / ArrowUp / PageDown / a single character).

clear.description: type: empty the field before typing (default true). Pass false to append.

submit.description: type: press Enter after typing (default false).

force.description: click: click even when the element is disabled / aria-disabled (default false).

gone.description: wait: wait until the target DISAPPEARS instead of appearing.

timeoutMs.description: wait: how long to wait (default 15000, max 600000).

selector.description: outline: override the element selector for the snapshot (default: buttons / links / inputs / cards / nodes).

textMax.description: outline: how many visible text lines to include alongside the element list (default 80, 0 = none).

offset.description: text: first visible line to return (0-based, default 0).

limit.description: text: how many lines to return (default 200).

dy.description: scroll: vertical delta in pixels (positive scrolls down).

expression.description: eval: a read-only JavaScript expression to evaluate inside the window and return.

path.description: screenshot: absolute output path (.png or .jpg). Required for screenshot.

canvasOnly.description: screenshot: shoot only the canvas viewport instead of the whole window.

hideUI.description: screenshot: hide transient menus / the image lightbox before shooting, then restore them.

delayMs.description: screenshot: wait this long before capturing (default 400 ms).

settleMs.description: After an action, wait this long for the page to settle (default 400, 0 = do not wait).

tools.name: mtnode_dev
tools.description:
Start a second MTNode client (dev mode, isolated data directory), drive it over CDP, then verify your fix on it. Use this when you are changing MTNode's own code and must SEE the result: launch → screenshot / snapshot → click / type → edit files → reload (renderer only) or restart (main process) → verify again.

Boundaries you must respect: this tool only ever touches the instance it started itself (ledger file), never the instance the user is working in; it refuses the default data directory; only one debug instance at a time; dev mode only (app.isPackaged === false).

Different from mtnode_gui: mtnode_gui drives the windows of the instance the user is using (main-process DOM injection). mtnode_dev drives the instance YOU started over CDP, and can read console / exceptions / network, which mtnode_gui cannot.

Actions:
- launch: spawn `electron .` with --remote-debugging-port and an isolated MTNODE_DATA_DIR (default <temp>/mtnode-dev/<timestamp>), wait until CDP answers, attach to the main window. Returns {ok, pid, port, dataDir, appDataDir, targetUrl}. Refuses when another debug instance is alive — stop or restart it instead.
- attach: re-attach the instance recorded in the ledger (e.g. after a gateway/runtime restart). A port different from the ledger one is refused on purpose.
- status: ledger + pid + port + dataDir + current target. Read-only.
- stop: close the instance (CDP Browser.close → wait → kill the process tree) and clear the ledger. The data directory is kept for the evidence you collected.
- reload: make new code take effect. Pass changedFiles (paths you just edited): renderer/… only → Page.reload; anything else (main.js, preload.js, root modules, dsh/, build.json) → full restart on the same data directory. how:"reload"|"restart" forces one.
- restart: stop + launch again on the same data directory.
- screenshot: write a PNG/JPG of the target window to an absolute path (path is required). delayMs waits before the shot.
- snapshot: target window's title / url / viewport / visible text + up to 120 interactive elements with coordinates. This is how you learn what to click.
- click: click an element target (see below) or an absolute {x,y}; mode:"dblclick" for double click.
- type: focus an element target (or the focused element) and insert text; clear:true empties the field first, submit:true presses Enter afterwards. Never for credentials.
- key: press one key (Enter / Escape / Tab / Backspace / arrows / PageDown / a single character).
- scroll: wheel by dx / dy (optionally at x / y).
- wait: wait until a target appears (or disappears with gone:true), timeoutMs default 15000 / max 600000.
- eval: evaluate a JavaScript expression in the target window and return its value (diagnostics; prefer click / type for anything that changes state).
- console: recent console + log entries (limit default 50).
- exceptions: recent uncaught exceptions and log errors.
- net: recent network requests / responses (method, url, status).

Windows (which): "main" (default, the main window renderer) · any substring of a window url or title (an app window is usually found by its app id or its title, e.g. "我的应用 (开发目录 v1.0.0)").

Element targets (click / type / wait): { css: "…" } · { text: "…", exact?: true } · { x, y } for an absolute point.

Failures are reported, never retried silently: an instance that will not start returns the error plus the last lines of its stdout/stderr — read them instead of retrying blindly.

which.description: Target window: "main" (default, the main window renderer) or a substring of a window url / title (app windows: their app id or title).

target.description: Element target: {css} or {text, exact?} or {x, y} for an absolute point.

text.description: type: the text to insert. wait: the text to wait for.

key.description: key: the key to press (Enter / Escape / Tab / Backspace / ArrowDown / PageDown / a single character).

expression.description: eval: JavaScript expression evaluated in the target window (returned by value).

path.description: screenshot: absolute output path (.png or .jpg). Required for screenshot.

changedFiles.description: reload: the files you just edited (absolute or repo-relative). renderer/… only → Page.reload; anything else → full restart. Required for reload unless how is given.

how.description: reload: force the strategy instead of deriving it from changedFiles.

dataDir.description: launch / restart: MTNODE_DATA_DIR for the debug instance (default <temp>/mtnode-dev/<timestamp>). The default data directory is refused.

clear.description: type: empty the field before typing (default true).

submit.description: type: press Enter after typing (default false).

gone.description: wait: wait until the target disappears instead of appearing.

timeoutMs.description: wait: how long to wait (default 15000, max 600000). launch: how long to wait for CDP (default 90000).

delayMs.description: screenshot: wait this long before capturing (default 0).

settleMs.description: After click / type / key / scroll, wait this long for the page to settle (default 400).

waitMs.description: reload: settle time after the reload (default 1200).

dy.description: scroll: vertical delta in pixels (positive scrolls down).

x.description: scroll: viewport x to wheel at (default 600).

y.description: scroll: viewport y to wheel at (default 400).

limit.description: console / exceptions / net: how many recent entries to return (default 50 / 50 / 60).

awaitPromise.description: eval: await the result when the expression returns a promise (default true).

tools.name: mtnode_generate
tools.description:
Generate media with MTNode itself (image / music / speech / video) — the same backends the canvas nodes use, with the same global audio-video mutex.
- 结果异步：run 立刻回 jobId（wait:true 则等到完成再回）。产物是**本机绝对路径**，并已进 MTNode 素材库。
- 只有显式给 canvas + baseHash 才会额外在画布上建一个节点（createNode 默认 false）。
- action:"status" 查作业（jobId）；action:"list" 列本次运行的全部作业；action:"cancel" 取消（音乐 / 视频有真取消口，图像 / 语音只能等它跑完）。
- 作业只活在这次进程里：MTNode 重启后未完成的作业回「作业已丢失」。

action.description: run（默认）= 起一个作业；status = 查作业；list = 列作业；cancel = 取消。

kind.description: run：生成哪一类。image = 文生图 / 图生图；speech = 语音（Breeze）；music = 音乐（MiniMax Music 3）；video = 视频（H3）。

prompt.description: image / music / video 的提示词（music 用它写曲风与演唱）。

lyrics.description: music：歌词正文（带结构标签，如 [Verse] / [Chorus]）。

text.description: speech：要念的台词正文（可用 [笑] 这类发声事件）。

voice.description: speech：音色（音色库 id 或名称；留空 = 用预设 / 参考音频）。

instruction.description: speech：语气 / 表演指令（一句话风格描述）。

refAudio.description: speech：参考音频的**本机绝对路径**（音色克隆）。

model.description: image：图像模型 id（留空 = 用本机已配的默认图像后端）。

size.description: image：尺寸，如 "1024x1024"（留空 = 后端默认）。

refImage.description: image：参考图的本机绝对路径（图生图）。

seed.description: 可复现随机种子（image / music / video）。

outputPath.description: 自定义产物路径（本机绝对路径）；留空 = 落 MTNode 托管目录。

canvas.description: 画布 id 或名称：给了才可能建节点，并决定产物落哪张画布的资产目录。

baseHash.description: createNode:true 时必填：先 canvas_get 拿到的 contentHash（版本校验）。

createNode.description: 在画布上额外建一个节点（需 canvas + baseHash；默认 false）。

wait.description: run：true = 等到作业结束再回（最长 15 分钟）；默认 false 立刻回 jobId。

tools.name: mtnode_run
tools.description:
Run a node or a whole graph inside MTNode, asynchronously.
- action:"node"：跑**一个**节点（媒体节点 / 智能任务 / 处理节点），必须给 canvas + baseHash（写前版本校验，与 canvas_edit 同一口径）。
- action:"graph"：从控制节点起跑一整张图（等价于点那颗控制节点的 ▶），**不要** baseHash。
- 立刻回 jobId；action:"status" 查进度与结果（节点输出 / 错误 / 产物绝对路径）。
- 长任务（视频 / 音乐）会排队等全局音视频锁；作业只活在这次进程里。

action.description: node（默认）= 跑一个节点；graph = 从控制节点起跑整图；status = 查作业；list = 列作业。

nodeId.description: node：节点 id（与 nodeTitle 二选一）。

canvas.description: 画布 id 或名称（node 必填；graph 留空 = 当前画布）。

baseHash.description: node 必填：canvas_get 拿到的 contentHash。graph 不要给。

controlNodeId.description: graph：指定从哪颗控制节点起跑（留空 = 画布上第一颗 ctrlAction=run 的控制节点）。

wait.description: node / graph：true = 等到跑完再回（最长 15 分钟）；默认 false 立刻回 jobId。

tools.name: mtnode_tools
tools.description:
Use the tools the user built in MTNode (tool nodes on the canvas + tool-library entries marked always-on).
- action:"list"：列可调用的用户工具（名称 / 说明 / 入参表）。
- action:"call"：按名称调用一次，args 用入参名（也认 arg1..argN），回各输出端子的值。
- 默认全部放行（与内置工具同级）；关掉「自用回环」总开关后，这一族与其它三项一起消失。

action.description: list = 列用户工具；call = 调一个。

name.description: call：工具名（action:"list" 回的名字，或它的 key）。

args.description: call：入参对象，键 = 工具的入参名（也认 arg1..argN）；图像参数给本机绝对路径。

canvas.description: 在哪张画布上找工具节点（留空 = 当前画布）。

detail.description: list：brief（默认，名称与说明）/ full（带完整入参表）。

tools.name: mtnode_session
tools.description:
Talk to an MTNode agent session (create / send / read / close) without touching the sessions the user is using.
- action:"create"：新建一条会话（左栏可见，标题标「外部调用」），默认**用完即弃**；给 keep:true 才保留。
- action:"send"：发一条消息并（默认 wait:true）等到这一轮结束，回助手最后一段回复；用完即弃的会话在这一轮后自动删除。
- action:"read"：读这条会话最近的消息；action:"close"：立刻删掉（keep 的会话不删，回一句说明）。
- 不读、不改用户自己的会话。

action.description: create（默认）= 新建；send = 发一条并等回复；read = 读最近消息；close = 删除。

sessionId.description: send / read / close：会话 id（as…）。send 留空 = 新建一条再发。

title.description: create / send：会话标题（留空 = 「外部调用 · 首句」）。

provider.description: create / send：供应商（route 或名称；留空 = 默认）。

model.description: create / send：模型 id（留空 = 默认）。

keep.description: create / send：true = 这条会话留在左栏（默认用完即弃）。

wait.description: send：true（默认）= 等到这一轮结束并回助手回复。

limit.description: read：最多回多少条消息（默认 20，上限 200）。
